Subject: Integration + Model routing & policy - Post-call recap

Samir / Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can align on scope and the technical kickoff.

Summary of needs (from your team):
- Embed search + summarization for support tickets (low latency for UI).
- Multi-region failover (US primary, EU DR).
- Policy controls: cost-sensitive routing for bulk async jobs, low-latency routing for interactive UI.
- Re-ranker/embedding pipeline for semantic search plus an API to call tools for structured outputs.

Key integration items we discussed:
- SDK setup & auth: Redwood SDK + API key or short-lived token via your IdP (we can support OIDC).
- Model routing: per-route policies (latency SLO vs cost target), fallback chains to smaller/cheaper models, and region routing rules.
- Structured output / tool calling: structured JSON responses + tool-call hooks for the agent flow you described.
- Embeddings & re-ranker: batch embedding ingestion to Redwood-managed vector service or self-hosted index; re-ranker as a second-stage model.

Attachments: I attached the integration guide and a starter SOW.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical kickoff / architecture working session — 60 min — propose Wed 12/9 or Thu 12/10 (Dev + Marcus will join).
2) Provide sample tenant policy: we'll send a draft routing/policy file and sample SDK auth snippet.
3) Share dev checklist & infra requirements (VPC peering, egress rules, KMS if needed).

Ask: Please confirm the preferred time for the architecture session and whether your infra team will join (Elena or procurement for SOW redline).

Thanks,

Samir / Elena — great, we'll plan for Wed 12/9 10:00am PT. Below is a compact tech checklist and a sample SDK/auth snippet you can share with your infra team. I'll post a more detailed checklist to the Drive link before the call.

Minimum network / infra checklist:
- Outbound HTTPS (443) to api.redwood.ai and region-specific endpoints.
- If using Private (VPC) deployment: VPN or VPC peering + NAT egress for updates.
- KMS/HSM endpoint whitelisting if key material stays in your network.
- Allowed CIDR ranges for our health/ops for Dedicated (we'll provide in follow-up).

Auth options (recommended):
1) Short-lived OIDC tokens from your IdP + Redwood token exchange (best for long-lived sessions).
2) API keys scoped to route + project (easiest for initial testing).

Sample SDK snippet (node):
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ endpoint: 'https://api.redwood.ai', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-llama-16k', input: 'Summarize the ticket...' });

Model routing & policy concepts to prep before the call:
- Route-level SLOs: define latency SLOs per route (UI vs batch).
- Fallback chains: e.g., primary redwood-llama-16k -> fallback redwood-llama-7b-8bit -> reroute to async batch for very long jobs.
- Cost caps: set monthly token spend for non-prod and batch pipelines to avoid surprise spend.
- Region routing: set rule to route EU-origin requests to EU nodes; failover to US if capacity issues with explicit notification.

Embeddings / re-ranker notes:
- Use batch embedding job to push vectors into your vector store (we support connector to Pinecone/Weaviate/elastic).
- Add a re-ranker route that calls a smaller cross-encoder; we can host as a second-stage model.

I'll bring Marcus to the call to walk through the routing policy draft and an example policy file.

Cheers,
